display.purpose: Landing hero headline and section heroes only. One instance per page maximum.

headline.purpose: Post titles in feed, page section titles, creator dashboard headings.

title.purpose: Card headings, dialog titles, sub-section labels within a post.

body.purpose: All post body copy. Max 68ch container width.

label.purpose: Tags, badges, meta dates, nav items, table column headers.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating UI only: dropdowns, popovers, tooltips, mobile sidebar sheet. Never applied to cards or sections at rest.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the primary CTA button on landing hero, hover state only. The terracotta glow. Use once.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions. Fast in, exponential out. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button hover fills, badge state changes, link underlines.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Card hover transitions, shadow appearance, blur change on locked post card.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Page section entrances, staggered content reveals (Framer Motion). Not used for button or form states.

narrative.overview:
Leith is a platform where restraint does the heavy lifting. Every screen is composed, almost dull, and then something lands: a proportion that's slightly off in a way that makes you pause, a color moment that doesn't need to announce itself, a heading weight that breaks the rhythm exactly once. The joke, when it exists, is quiet. The technique is always legible.

The visual system is built on warm aged-paper tones with a single terracotta accent used with deliberate scarcity. Space Grotesk brings character at display scale without performing. Instrument Sans carries the body copy with warmth and no fuss. Surfaces are almost flat. Shadows appear only when elevation is structurally required.

This system explicitly rejects: hype streetwear aggression, dark AI portal aesthetics, generic SaaS warmth, and newsletter minimalism.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper base, not sterile white
One accent color, used sparingly (terracotta earns its appearance)
Space Grotesk display with tight tracking; Instrument Sans body with generous leading
Borderless where possible, 1px border where structure is needed, no ambient shadows

rules.name: The One Punch Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears on at most one primary element per screen. Its rarity is the source of its punch. When it shows up everywhere, it becomes wallpaper.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Doctrine
rules.body: Surface and Ink are never pure white or pure black. Every neutral carries H=60-80 at C=0.006-0.010.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Display and Headline always have negative tracking. Any Space Grotesk heading above 1.25rem without letter-spacing: -0.02em or tighter has not been set; it has been pasted.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk is the heading font. Instrument Sans is the body font. No third typeface is introduced, including monospace.

rules.name: The No Ambient Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, sections, containers, and panels are never shadowed at rest. If a surface needs to look elevated, use a 1px border-border instead.

dos: Do use oklch for all color values in globals.css
Do tint every neutral. Surface is oklch(0.97 0.008 80), Ink is oklch(0.15 0.008 60)
Do use Space Grotesk at negative tracking for any heading above 1.125rem
Do enforce max line length in post body copy: max-width 68ch
Do use 1px border-border as the primary depth signal on cards
Do keep the terracotta accent scarce: one primary element per screen
Do use Surface Tint for hover fills, tag backgrounds, and active row states
Do use min-h-[100dvh] instead of h-screen for full-height hero sections
Do use asymmetric layouts on the landing page
donts: Don't use hype streetwear energy: no aggressive red, no drop-culture type treatment
Don't use dark AI portal aesthetics: no neon on black, no glowing orbs
Don't use generic SaaS patterns: no cream bg with purple accent, no rounded card grids, no hero metrics
Don't use newsletter minimalism: pure white + Georgia serif is not this platform's personality
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient
Don't add ambient shadows to cards or sections at rest
Don't use more than one typeface family
Don't use oklch(1 0 0) or oklch(0 0 0) without a hue tilt
Don't animate top, left, width, or height — animate transform and opacity only
